knowledge:
- key_parameters: use_marker=logical indicating whether to use marker genes/proteins in AJIVE ;; refactor_loading=logical, set to TRUE in ajive_decomp to enhance joint deconvolution and enable cross-source feature selection ;; source=character, set to "cross" for cross-source deconvolution ;; method=character, set to "JNMF" for Joint Non-negative Matrix Factorization ;; Step=numeric vector of step sizes for JNMF optimization (e.g., c(10^(-9), 10^(-7))) ;; use_refactor=numeric, number of features to use after refactoring ;; pinit=matrix of initial cell-type proportions (e.g., from transcriptome deconvolution) ;; ref_pnl=matrix of known cellular signatures (must be non-negative and have the same rescaling transformation as bulk data) ;; filter_method=character vector of filtering methods, options include "allele", "distance", or "null" ;; filter_allele=numeric, threshold for minor allele frequency ;; filter_geno=numeric, threshold for the fraction of samples in the smallest genotype group ;; ref_position=character, reference position for distance filtering (e.g., "TSS")
- alternatives: nnls is supported for single-source deconvolution, but users can use external methods like CIBERSORT or MuSiC to obtain initial proportion estimates (pinit). AJIVE is preferred over standard PCA (prcomp) when finding joint modes of variation shared across multiple matched data sources. csQTL mapping is performed using the TOAST method.
- when_to_use: Use this pipeline when you have matched bulk transcriptome and proteome data from the same set of samples, along with genotype data (SNPs), and want to estimate cell-type proportions, visualize joint multi-omic variation, and map cell-type-specific QTLs.
- pitfalls: Samples used in cell-type proportion estimates must exactly match the samples in the bulk protein expression data. The reference matrix ref_pnl must have the same rescaling transformation (e.g., log or MinMax) as the bulk transcriptomes/proteomics and must be non-negative. If estimated cell-type proportions contain invalid or non-finite values, the Step parameter in deconv must be adjusted. The feature_filter function must be run even if no filtering is expected (by setting filter_method = "null") to ensure a consistent object format for downstream analysis. The rowData of the SummarizedExperiment must contain "Chr", "Start", "End", and "Symbol" columns, and metadata must contain "SNP_data" and "anno_SNP" with "CHROM", "POS", and "ID" columns.

workflows.name: multi_omic_csqtl_pipeline
workflows.intent: Perform joint deconvolution of bulk proteomes using matched transcriptomes, visualize joint variation, filter features, and map cell-type-specific quantitative trait loci (csQTLs).
input: your_protein_data (matrix of bulk protein expression data)
your_anno_protein (data frame of protein annotations with Chr, Start, End, Symbol)
your_gene_data (data frame of bulk gene expression data)
prop_gene (matrix of pre-defined deconvoluted transcriptome proportions)
ref_gene (matrix of known cellular gene signatures)
anno_SNP (data frame of SNP annotations with CHROM, POS, ID)
workflows.stages: 1. Initialize the SummarizedExperiment object with bulk protein data, protein annotations, and gene expression data. ;; 2. Perform AJIVE decomposition to extract joint variation and select features. ;; 3. Deconvolve cell-type proportions using Joint Non-negative Matrix Factorization (JNMF). ;; 4. Visualize joint variation using common normalized scores from AJIVE. ;; 5. Filter features (proteins/genes and SNPs) based on allele frequency, genotype group size, and genomic distance. ;; 6. Perform cell-type-specific QTL (csQTL) mapping using the TOAST method.
workflows.code:
se <- SummarizedExperiment(
    assays = list(protein = your_protein_data),
    rowData = your_anno_protein
)
metadata(se) <- list(
    gene_data = your_gene_data
)
se <- ajive_decomp(se, use_marker = FALSE, refactor_loading = TRUE)
se <- deconv(se, source = "cross", method = "JNMF",
             Step = c(10^(-9), 10^(-7)),
             use_refactor = 1000,
             pinit = se@metadata$prop_gene,
             ref_pnl = se@metadata$ref_gene)
se <- ajive_decomp(se, plot = TRUE,
                   group_var = "disease",
                   scatter = TRUE, scatter_x = "cns_1", scatter_y = "cns_2")
metadata(se)$cns_plot
target_protein <- rowData(se)[rowData(se)$Chr == 9, ][seq_len(3), "Symbol"]
se <- feature_filter(se,
    target_protein = target_protein,
    filter_method = c("allele", "distance"),
    filter_allele = 0.15,
    filter_geno = 0.05,
    ref_position = "TSS"
)
system.time(se <- csQTL(se))
res <- metadata(se)$TOAST_output[[2]]
head(res[order(apply(res, 1, min)), ])
